summary: Nucleus BATCH A (security) + BATCH B (rules/reminders, boards, notes & lists) tested end-to-end on Expo web preview (mobile viewport 390x844). Backend skipped per request (unused stub, no .env). Encryption-at-rest confirmed: localStorage['nucleus.db.v1'] starts with 'NCE1.' and localStorage['secure:nucleus.dek.v1'] exists; data decrypts correctly after reload. PIN flow (1234 x2) sets lock with 'App lock is on' toast; cold reload shows lock-screen; error labels 'Incorrect PIN · 2 left' / '1 left' appear on 3rd/4th wrong attempts; correct PIN unlocks after backoff expires. Unlock-method Biometric on web correctly toasts 'No enrolled biometrics on this device' and stays on PIN. Per-module lock: enabling settings-module-lock-money causes /money to render module-gate-money, while /vehicles is NOT gated (OK). Clipboard switch exists. Encrypted backup export: password 'nucleus-test-pass' shows 'Fair · Mix in another character type' strength, Export now triggers 'Backup ready' toast with no crash. Rules: 2 sample rules present ('Renewals heads-up', 'Big spend check') with matching/sentence/toggle; builder works (tripStart trigger, value chip, name 'TEST_Trip rule', dry-run line 'Dry run: this would have fired about 0 times in the last 90 days', save → count 2→3). Notes: 2 sample notes; new note with 2 checklist items (one ticked) + pin saved → count 2→3; 'Pinned notes' tile appears on Today. Boards: today-board-new opens BoardSheet with name/icon/tiles; added 2 tiles via board-add-tile-* and saved → new board visible on Today. Search 'goa' returns NOTES & LISTS group with 'Before the Goa trip · 1/3 done'. Attention tab loads with 3 urgent + 7 upcoming + 4 info (incl. Netflix renewal from rule, Bedroom AC overdue). One important discrepancy: the spec says 'Enter wrong PIN 5 times -> countdown must appear' but the implementation (security.ts registerFailure: over = fails - 5; wait only when over > 0) gives 5 FREE attempts and the countdown appears on the 6th wrong attempt — this matches /app/memory/test_credentials.md ('5 free attempts, then a 30 s countdown') so it's a spec-text mismatch, not a code bug. All referenced features work.
action_items: Spec vs. implementation wording: the review request says 'Enter wrong PIN 5 times -> countdown must appear', but security.ts gives 5 free attempts and the countdown fires on the 6th failure (matches test_credentials.md). Either tighten the spec to '>5 wrong attempts' or change security.ts so `over = fails - 4` to make the 5th wrong attempt start the backoff. Reference: /app/frontend/src/core/security.ts:53-61 and /app/memory/test_credentials.md.

Carryover: iteration_2 noted a possible deprecated 'pointerEvents' prop usage in Sheet overlays. Not re-verified; please confirm Sheet.tsx uses style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/Sheet.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Encryption layer in /app/frontend/src/core/crypto.ts is clean: single `NCE1.` envelope prefix, 12-byte IV, AES-256-GCM via @noble/ciphers, device key kept in SecureStore (web localStorage 'secure:' namespace). loadSecureDoc gracefully handles legacy plaintext.
security.ts back-off is persisted (secureStorage key nucleus.backoff.v1) so it survives reload — good. Doubling cap at 30 min is reasonable. See spec/code discrepancy noted above.

LockGate correctly re-locks after background > lockTimeoutSec and offers Forgot PIN → erase; renders above navigator so navigation state is preserved. ModuleGate is a transparent cover over the module screen (not a route) so going back works naturally.

backup.ts exportBackup/mergeDB design: encrypted envelope stored under 'file' with 'encrypted:true' and PasswordEnvelope; mergeDB preserves local settings (lockEnabled/unlockMethod/biometricEnabled/moduleLocks) which is correct for a restore. mergePreview returns per-collection counts.

Rules engine (/app/frontend/src/core/rules.ts) uses pure-functional evaluateRule + dryRun; TRIGGERS metadata drives both the builder chips and the sentence generator — adding a new trigger kind in one place lights up all UI.

Notes module cleanly re-uses LinkedSection for cross-record linking; `linked-add-note` handler on /record creates a note and routes to /notes?id=... (verified by code: deep link reads params.id in Notes()).
BoardSheet is a small, well-scoped component (<100 lines). Tiles are reordered via a pure `move` helper and persisted via setSettings — single source of truth.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (every listed feature works; only a spec-vs-code wording mismatch on wrong-PIN threshold)

seed_data_creation: Used in-app onboarding-finish-sample-button (vehicles Activa/Swift, Goa 2026 trip, 3 appliances, 6 months of transactions, 4 subscriptions, 2 rules, 2 notes).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fresh browser each playwright invocation — do onboarding + feature test in a single script. Onboarding = 3x onboarding-next-button → onboarding-finish-sample-button. Tabs: tab-today / tab-modules / tab-attention / tab-settings. PinPad keys: `${testID}-key-${digit}` (e.g. settings-pin-key-1, lock-pin-key-9, module-gate-money-pin-key-1). The LockGate re-triggers on cold start, so using page.goto to switch routes while app lock is ON will put the lock-screen back in front of the module-gate; unlock first, then use client-side router pushes (or expect module-gate rendered BEHIND lock-screen). Backoff kicks in on the 6th wrong PIN (not 5th), per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. On web, biometrics are unavailable and notifications only warn; `No enrolled biometrics on this device` toast is expected. Encrypted export requires strength score ≥1 (bar fills past 'Weak') to enable the Export now button. BoardSheet starts with a default 'Attention' tile; today-board-row shows the 'Today' + 'New board' chips (today-board-new to open the sheet).
rca_of_issue: Backoff timing discrepancy (not a bug, documentation nit): the review request asks the countdown to appear after 5 wrong attempts, but security.ts:registerFailure returns {until: 0} when fails<=5 and only sets a wait when fails>5. The lock UI therefore shows 'Incorrect PIN · N left' for attempts 3/4 and 'Incorrect PIN' for attempt 5, with the lock-backoff-countdown testID appearing only from attempt 6. test_credentials.md explicitly documents the '5 free attempts' behaviour, so the implementation is self-consistent — only the review-request wording is loose. Mitigation A (preferred): clarify the spec to say 'after 5 wrong attempts the next (6th) try is blocked by a 30 s countdown'. Mitigation B: change `over = fails - 5` to `over = fails - 4` in registerFailure to make the 5th wrong PIN trigger the countdown.
